map.既有建筑改变使用功能前，快速筛查原耐火等级能否满足新功能要求。: Before an existing building changes use, quickly screen whether the original fire-resistance rating can meet the new functional requirements.
map.消防检查中核对防火墙、承重墙、柱、梁、楼板等构件的耐火极限是否达标。: In fire inspections, verify whether the fire-resistance limits of the fire wall, load-bearing wall, column, beam, floor slab and other members meet the standard.
map.50 m 重要公共建筑的等级判定: Rating determination for a 50 m important public building
map.按默认参数（公共建筑、高度 50 m、重要建筑、非地下）：判为二类高层公共建筑，: With the default parameters (public building, height 50 m, important building, not underground): rated a Class II high-rise public building, requiring a fire-resistance rating not lower than Grade II; main-member fire-resistance limits: fire wall 3.0 h, load-bearing wall 2.5 h, column 2.5 h, beam 1.5 h, floor slab 1.0 h (all ≥ Grade II requirements). If it were an underground building, the fire-resistance rating should not be lower than Grade I.
map.一级和二级耐火等级差在哪？: How do Grade I and Grade II fire-resistance ratings differ?
map.差别主要体现在承重墙、柱、梁、楼板的耐火极限：一级柱 3.0 h、梁 2.0 h: The difference is mainly in the fire-resistance limits of the load-bearing wall, column, beam and floor slab: Grade I has column 3.0 h, beam 2.0 h, floor slab 1.5 h; Grade II has column 2.5 h, beam 1.5 h, floor slab 1.0 h. Important buildings and high-rise buildings must take a higher grade.
map.构件耐火极限怎么确认？: How is a member's fire-resistance limit confirmed?
map.须通过耐火试验、计算或既有检测报告确认，不能仅凭材料推断；验收时以检测/计算结论: It must be confirmed by fire-resistance testing, calculation or an existing inspection report and cannot be inferred from material alone; acceptance is based on the test/calculation conclusion, while this tool gives the code-required limits.
